Our story.

Senva Health grew out of research at Umeå University. We’re building a saliva test that shows how fast you’re ageing and what you can change, analysed and kept safe in Europe.

Who we are.

Antón Carcedo

Co-founder and CTO. Leads the science and technology.

Computational biologist and PhD candidate in physics at Umeå University, researching how DNA methylation changes as we age.

Antón on LinkedIn

Åke Brännström

Co-founder and CEO. Leads strategy, product and partnerships.

Professor of mathematics at Umeå University, working in mathematical biology. He oversees the development of Senva’s model of epigenetic ageing.

Åke on LinkedIn

Supported by Umeå University.

Senva grew out of research at Umeå University. We’re supported by the university’s Innovation Office and by Umeå University Holding through its Venture Track programme.

Our journey.

From a research idea at Umeå University to a test you can take at home.

Follow along on LinkedIn

We post each step there first.

Follow Antón Follow Åke

Share Senva on LinkedIn

  1. Nov 2025

    We start building the model

    Work begins at Umeå University on our own epigenetic model, built for saliva from the start.

  2. Apr 2026

    Into Venture Track

    Funding from Umeå University Holding’s Venture Track lets us take the model from research towards a product.

  3. Sep 2026

    EpiVida becomes Senva

    We chose a new name. Senva comes from the Latin sentire, to sense.

  4. 6 Oct 2026

    First volunteer samples

    The first saliva samples from volunteers went to the lab, the first step in checking the test before launch.

  5. 20 Oct 2026

    Pitching Senva at SKERIC Week

    We presented Senva at SKERIC Week, the Sweden-Korea collaboration on education, research and innovation, with KTH Innovation.

  6. 2027

    Launch in the EU

    The test goes on sale in the EU. Join the waiting list to hear first.

How we’re making sure it works.

Before launch, we’re testing the test. Volunteers give saliva samples, and repeat samples taken over time show whether results are consistent and how they change. We’ll share more as the work progresses.

For investors and partners.

Senva is at the pre-seed stage, funded through Umeå University Holding’s Venture Track programme. We’d like to hear from:

  • Investors who share our view of healthy ageing.
  • Labs and wellness companies that would like to work with us.
  • Organisations interested in a pilot around our launch in 2027.

Write to Åke Brännström, CEO: ake.brannstrom@umu.se

senva

Senva Health is a spin-out from Umeå University, being set up as a company in Umeå, Sweden, with support from the university’s Innovation Office and Umeå University Holding.

The name comes from the Latin sentire, to sense.
